$comment: ss#2320. The overlay's ACCEPTED_ACTION_TYPES (operator/hermes-smd-overlay/plugins/hermes-smd-audit/schemas.py), snapshotted here so a type the seat runtime can write is also a type this repo's portal can render: shared/audit_contract.py validates nothing at the INSERT, so without this list a row of an unknown type lands in a client ledger and renders as nothing, indistinguishable from a deliberate suppression. tests/audit-vocabulary-parity.test.ts reads the live source (one repository since the 2026-10-22 fold, ADR 0095) and fails when this snapshot and the source disagree, and when an overlay type is neither known here nor declared in overlayOnly with a reason. consoleOnly names the types written by console-owned code on the seat (the workspace broker) that the overlay plugin never emits. The history of every re-stamp lives in this file's git log, not here (tests/no-history-in-file-bodies.test.ts).
overlayOnlyNote: Declared by the overlay, absent from this repo's AUDIT_ACTION_TYPES. Each needs a reason, because an overlay-only type that ever gains an emitter writes rows the portal renders as nothing. None of these has an emitter at the pinned ref (they appear only in the declaration), which is why they are tolerated rather than fixed. 2026-08-18 re-stamp 20518e86 -> 0716dc17: compare API shows zero action_type deltas in the range (only hermes-smd-reply internals, matter_binding, docs, tests); vocabulary re-derivation is the identity. 2026-08-18 re-stamp af0c8a0f -> 0088352a: plugins/hermes-smd-audit/schemas.py untouched in the range (single commit, file list is msgraph poller/replay/consumes/tests only); vocabulary re-derivation is the identity.

consoleOnlyNote: Declared here, absent from the overlay vocabulary. These are written by CONSOLE-side producers (the decommission pipeline, the wake path, the customer.yaml sync, the admin console), never by the seat runtime, so the overlay has no reason to know them. Harmless in the direction that matters: a console-written row is already rendered from this repo's own vocabulary. 2026-08-22 (ss#2546): RULE_REQUEST_NOTIFIED, RULE_DECLINED and RULE_LAPSED are declared here at PR 1 while the overlay half is still unmerged. Two of the three are genuinely console-side (the workspace broker writes them). RULE_REQUEST_NOTIFIED is not - it is written by the seat's establishment hook - and it sits here for exactly one release so the portal is never handed a row it cannot name. ALL THREE MOVE INTO overlayTypes AT THE OVERLAY_REF BUMP IN PR 3, re-extracted by AST at the new ref rather than transcribed. 2026-08-23 (ss#2546, the operations half): OPS_REQUEST_RECORDED, OPS_REQUEST_RESOLVED and OPS_REQUEST_LAPSED are declared here, and unlike RULE_REQUEST_NOTIFIED above they are genuinely console-side for good - all three are written by the workspace broker (operator/workspace_broker/establishment.py: ops_propose, ops_resolve, and establish_lapse_notified on a row of kind ops_request), which appends to the hash-chained ledger directly, so the overlay's hermes-smd-audit plugin neither emits nor validates them and its vocabulary does not gate the write. They are declared in the SAME PR as the broker that writes them, so there is no window in which a client ledger can hold a row this repo cannot name. IF the paired overlay PR chooses to declare them in plugins/hermes-smd-audit/schemas.py as well - which it may, for the reason CORRECTION_PROPOSED and RULE_DECLINED are declared there, so the overlay vocabulary names every type a ledger can contain - then they move out of consoleOnly and into overlayTypes at that OVERLAY_REF bump, re-extracted by AST at the new ref rather than transcribed. The parity gate that every console-only type is genuinely absent from the overlay is what makes forgetting that move loud.

consoleOnly.MEDCHRON_JOB_SUBMITTED: ss#2614 routine 11. consoleOnly.MEDCHRON_ALLOWANCE_CREDITED: 2026-10-29. Broker-written on the root-only medchron_allowance_credit verb: SMD waived pages from the firm's cycle page allowance. Credit id, pages, who, the job id; never the free-text reason.
consoleOnly.MEDCHRON_JOB_HELD: ss#2614. Broker-written when the runner holds (a seat at HARD_STOP, an unexplained file, an unmatched folder) or refuses (the cents cap, the allowance); the reason travels in metadata as prose, never a document.
consoleOnly.MEDCHRON_JOB_DELIVERED: ss#2614. Broker-written on delivery: documents read, pages, cents, the folder id, and the file names with sha256 and byte counts read back from the matter.
consoleOnly.MEDCHRON_JOB_FAILED: ss#2614. Broker-written when the runner exits without a verdict or a stage fails; the reason is the runner's sentence.
consoleOnly.MEDCHRON_COVERAGE_BACKFILLED: ss#2834. Broker-written when a chronology delivered BEFORE the coverage record existed gets one, recomputed from that delivery's own artifacts. Root-only verb, no agent tool: an update skips whatever the record says was covered, so a path the agent could reach is a path a client conversation could use to make a chronology omit records. Metadata carries counts, the source, and the delivery date, never the document ids -- the audit log is not a second copy of the record. A live-state write with no governance trail is the 2026-09-01 sticky-stop incident; this type is that trail.
consoleOnly.MEDCHRON_COVERAGE_RECOMPUTED: 2026-10-29. Broker-written by the root-only medchron_covered_recompute verb when a DELIVERED job's coverage record is replaced with one recomputed from its own job directory on the seat (python -m medchron.covered_backfill): a joint matter's record had every cited exhibit of both clients uncovered. Metadata carries the job id and the covered/uncovered set sizes before and after, never the document ids.
consoleOnly.REPLY_BINDING: The verified reply binding (operator/workspace_broker/reply_binding.py). Broker-written on every verdict of msgraph_reply_bind / msgraph_reply_bound: outcome (bound, bind_refused, bind_error, send_refused, send_error, send_released, send_unknown), the binding kind and key, the Graph and RFC 5322 ids of the email, a hashed sender, and the reason for a refusal; never a body. Console-owned source running on the seat, so the overlay vocabulary does not gate the write.
